Name: Upgraded Fish Smoker
Author: betterlch
Description:
[size=5][b]Upgraded Fish Smoker 升级版熏鱼机[/b][/size]
[line]
[b][size=4]Description 简介[/size][/b]

Four tiers of upgraded fish smokers (copper → iron → gold → iridium) that smoke up to 2/4/8/16 fish per batch using just 1 coal. Higher tiers have a chance to upgrade the whole batch's quality. All upgrade chances scale with your Daily Luck.
四档升级版熏鱼机（铜→铁→金→铱），单批最多熏 2/4/8/16 条鱼，每批只耗 1 块煤。高级机器有概率提升整批鱼的品质。所有提升概率受每日运气影响。

[b][size=4]Installation 安装[/size][/b]

[b]1.[/b] Install SMAPI
[b]2.[/b] Unzip and drop the Upgraded Fish Smoker folder into your Mods directory (Vortex users can import the zip directly)
[b]3.[/b] Launch the game. Recipes are sold at Willy's fish shop (requires the vanilla Fish Smoker recipe first)

/

[b]1.[/b] 安装 SMAPI；
[b]2.[/b] 解压 zip，将 Upgraded Fish Smoker 文件夹放入 Mods 目录（Vortex 可直接导入）；
[b]3.[/b] 启动游戏，威利鱼店逐级出售配方（需先拥有原版熏鱼机配方）。

[b][size=4]Main Features 主要功能[/size][/b]

• Four tiers, 2/4/8/16 fish per batch, 1 coal per batch, output = input count
• Per-batch quality rolls (quality +1): iron 33% / gold 50% / iridium 67%, influenced by Daily Luck
• Tier skips (quality +2): gold tier normal→gold; iridium tier normal→gold & silver→iridium (10% base, 0–20% with luck)
• Quality never drops — iridium fish stay iridium in any smoker
• GMCM config: finished-machine shop toggle, price presets, per-tier batch size sliders
• Simplified Chinese translation included

/

• 四档机器单批 2/4/8/16 条、1 煤/批；
• 品质提升逐炉判定：铁 33%/金 50%/铱 67%，联动每日运气；
• 跳级：金机普通→金，铱机普通→金、银→铱（基础 10%，随运气 0~20%）；
• 品质永不降低（铱品质鱼在任意升级熏鱼机内保留品质）；
• GMCM 可配置直购开关、价格档位、分级容量滑条；
• 内置简体中文。
